entities.name: Janelle Salaün
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Janelle Illona Salaün is a French professional basketball player for the Golden State Valkyries of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA) and USK Praha of the Czech Women's Basketball League. Salaün plays for the France women's national basketball team and was part of the French team at the 2024 Summer Olympics, where she won a silver medal.
